      "observations": [
        "All nine owned files and all 344 historical diff lines were read. The patch adds a preference-gated Graph XML protocol, distinct ews/owa URL entries, an optional generic incoming.url property, Graph option markup/strings, and an XML Accept header on the ISPDB lookup.",
        "When url is present, the parser sanitizes it, derives hostname from parsedUrl.host, and derives SSL/plain from its scheme. URL failures are caught locally, but later socket/auth/hostname admission checks still apply. This is not a claim that every malformed entry is accepted or that isComplete no longer needs a port.",
        "Graph and EWS populate internal exchangeURL; OWA populates owaURL. The combined exchange branch still reads external ewsURL. Existing focused lesson a9c410875c2d8415e60b26aab0f550e95405fbe8574c03d6d72af8059b167a30 covers that external-schema/internal-model distinction and is reused rather than restated as a new schema rule.",
        "The actual current InputSanitizer receiver and fetchHTTP header loop were read. The header is forwarded to XMLHttpRequest; no network negotiation or server response was exercised. Hostname cleanup internals, provider registry semantics and upstream URL implementation remain bounded dependencies; no port-edge failure is projected.",
        "The new unit test checks URL normalization, hostname, socket type, username and OAuth2. The owned browser test makes Graph available but still selects EWS; it does not prove a Graph account can be created. All newly added assertions have nonempty expected-behavior messages; the unit test's manual preference reset is separate from the accepted browser test's later pushPrefEnv scope.",
        "Accepted source retains the core parser and UI branches with a later InputSanitizer rename, expanded localized protocol labels and hidden single-server port details. The accepted fixture changes graph.exchange.test/v1.0/ to graph.exchange.test/. The current transport API-version contract is a separate later source phase covered by existing lesson 96fd47a6de69ee2f388e44f7906a3416644764c23239a8e209556bcf5c0e3041.",
        "The current select-config JSDoc's parenthesized type examples omit EWS and Graph while the implementation handles both. This is a bounded comment completeness issue, not a failure of selection. The new parser guards and nested try/catch blocks were checked as separate URL, authentication and admission steps; no unrelated style rewrite is proposed.",
        "Full required Bug 1995836 current comments 0–3 and D284147 creation-to-final timeline, eight actual current/historical inline bodies and the tentative pseudo-code block were read from exact registered originals. Parent read the primary and C3 read the review. No summary/test-plan edit history exists.",
        "The reviewer asks about Graph entries received while disabled; the author proposes filtering during allowed-type sanitization. Owned source actually gates supportedProtocols on mail.graph.enabled. The optional mapping-table/single-try pseudo-code is expressly deferred because D285808/Bug2018801 will unify URLs, and the landed separate branches confirm it was not adopted here.",
        "The ms-graph greppability suggestion is acknowledged but deferred to a spec-level decision; actual owned and current code keep graph. This is not a global naming rule or verification of the external draft. The explicit XML Accept-header rationale matches source forwarding, without a network result. External ISPDB PR179, draft/provider pages, later2024076 regression and D285808 bodies remain bounded unread locators.",
        "Historical lint conflicts, repeated remote completion, Try links, acceptance and landing remain separate from static parser assertions and source adoption. No Graph discovery, account creation or protocol execution occurred."
